epics.goal: Define the blend design system ONCE (tokens, keyframes, shared primitives) so every screen composes the two aesthetics instead of forking hex/keyframes per screen.

crossCutting: Shared token + component layer is the keystone: gold, green-wash (#e7f4ee), warm-green-black + green-glow shadows, capsule/circle radii and the breathing-pulse keyframe must be defined ONCE (derived from oklch via color-mix so they work in dark/theme) plus shared MonoSheet, CaptionChip, SegmentedToggle, AvatarCircle/SportMedallion/LiveDot, EmptyState. Every screen consumes these; nothing forks per-screen hex or keyframes.

Real-time / live / spectator infrastructure is missing from production (LiveBroadcastBar, ShareLiveMatch, LiveMatchCard, convex/live.ts, watchUrl exist only in worktrees). Resolve the canonical worktree, land it to src/ + convex/, then add a public per-match snapshot query + share-token guard (respecting §7.2 minimization + youth name-hiding) before ANY spectator/share/live-feed screen.

Shared coaching-status selectors (per-sport) must be a single util consumed by every scorer chip, spectator screen and the dashboard live band so labels can't drift; presentational chips are fed labels and never embed sport rules.

Player-stats + roster-in-scoring data model and a persisted per-point/ball event log are prerequisite backends: attribution sheets, momentum/point-by-point viz, spectator graphs, and team-stats depth are all hollow until these land (draftState is discarded on completion today; scorers track team scores only).

Social layer (friends schema + convex/friends.ts) and Teams membership model + convex/teams functions are prerequisite backends; every add-friend CTA and team screen is a dead button until they exist and must be feature-flagged/cloud-auth-gated with anon sign-in-to-sync fallbacks.

Bottom-nav information architecture (Home·Play·History·Friends/More) is cross-cutting: it reworks isActive/isAppShellPath/navItems across every shell screen and fixes I-066 Stats-vs-Statistics; screens must degrade gracefully until it lands and it should NOT be built inside any per-screen PR.

Monolith decomposition first: extract MonoQuickSetup from MonoQuickMatch (I-085) as a pure lift before restyling Setup/Toss/Customize; treat Tournament shell extraction + ~113-instance blue→--se-* migration as its own no-visual PR before the tournament blend.

Dark mode is declared-but-unused (@custom-variant only, zero .dark rules) — author the .dark oklch token set as its own issue so the Settings Appearance toggle isn't a dead switch; ship the toggle disabled/coming-soon until it lands, and wire the inert Confirm-wicket/goal + Auto-share toggles into their consumers in a separate PR.

Match-end flow (Result → Scorecard → Share card) is entirely missing; build the sport-agnostic MonoMatchResult with a lineScores[] contract first, wire Sets as reference, then roll out — MonoLiveGame is a different session engine and rolls out separately.

Attribution capture, share-card rasterization, momentum charts, and share/QR sheets are shared primitives repeatedly requested across scorers/spectator/history — build each ONCE (AppAttributionSheet, shareCardImage/canvas, MomentumChart, MonoShareLiveSheet) and consume, never fork per screen.

Empty/first-run states and team-only (anonymous, no-roster) casual mode are cross-cutting UX gaps: reuse the shared EmptyState everywhere and make team-only the single OFF gate (useTeamOnlyMode) that future attribution shares.

Verify open status in the kernel before re-fixing design-debt (I-044 tiny fonts, I-047 CTA feedback, I-049 disabled-look, I-051/I-052 non-uniform score buttons, I-068 ad-hoc green 4/6, I-053 perpetual-loading, I-086 filter-heavy history) — several already have fix-comments shipped; fold the still-open ones into their screen issue rather than a separate pass.

Numerous verified factual slips in the source designs must be honored at build time (many 'keeps brutalist' hard-offset shadows do NOT exist today and are new work; radius.pill=999px not 99px; --shadow-md is not zero-blur; several 'reuse' claims target absent components/tests) — treat invented preservation as new work and write characterization tests before extracting untested logic (e.g. tennis derivation helpers).
